Self-hosted, pinned, byte-identical upstream builds (npm registry, 2026-09-04) with their source maps alongside. File names carry a content hash: NEVER edit a vendor file in place (they are cached as immutable) — add a new file and repoint the import map in tools/bake.mjs.
